preReview.title: Ipswich boss O'Neil takes 'lots of positives' from Arsenal defeat
preReview.description: Ipswich Town's momentum was halted by Arsenal midweek, but they will be hoping to enter the international break with a win at Everton.

preReview.description: El Arsenal frenó entre semana la buena dinámica del Ipswich Town, que buscará llegar al parón internacional con una victoria ante el Everton.

preReview.description: L'Arsenal ha frenato lo slancio dell'Ipswich Town in settimana, ma i Tractor Boys puntano a vincere sul campo dell'Everton prima della sosta per le nazionali.
